profile.headline: Software Engineer, Agentic Commerce @ PayPal
profile.summary:
I’m an energetic and driven engineer who is an avid learner with experience in founding a small business startup and a passion for tennis. I enjoy collaborating with others as much as I do contributing to meaningful projects. 

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Languages​
• Javascript (Primary)
• Typescript (Primary) 
• Java (dabbled)

Client-Side​
• React
• NextJS
• Apollo
• Redux
• HTML, CSS, Node Sass
• Mantine

Server-Side​
• Node
• Express
• RESTful API
• GraphQL

Database​
• Postgres SQL / Sequelize ORM (Primary)
• MongoDB / Mongoose ODM
• Redis

Testing​ & Deployment
• Jest, RTL
• Mockito, JUnit
• CircleCI
• AWS

Dev Tools​
• Git, GitHub, Bitbucket
• Webpack
• Babel
• NPM
• Chrome-Dev-Tools
• VSCode, IntelliJ
• Postman
• Brew

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
TS ● Next  ● React ● Node ● GQL ● RMQ

● Collaborated on a small team (3 engineers, 2 designers) responsible for redesigning our app to reduce future frontend engineering time by 50%. Accomplished using generic components with typed configs.
● Integrated legacy app into new NextJs application using an iframe with event handlers for communication.
● Created spotlight action shortcuts based on url params to surface 10 most useful actions.
● Modified Apollo Client to serve requests for CSR and SSR while maintaining apollo caching efficiency.
Spearheaded new internal Dispositions workflow to bring off-platform data into main application and create a seamless user experience with a more linear flow to prevent user errors during sale of a property. 
● Integrated Amplitude data analytics to allow us to track new application metrics and user behavior.
Assisted in onboarding several engineers to ramp up their knowledge base for quicker productivity. 
● Project Lead for implementing and maintaining new Comparables tool. Created UI/UX, communicated with new in-house listing service for mls data and data science services for 10x increased coverage.
● Automated admin workflows for helping users buyback homes at the end of their lease. Contributed in database design decisions for new automated flow, implemented backend APIs for saving and updating of data, and integrated front end components for teams' work that was completed in parallel.  Reduced overall time of buyback process by 5-10x.
● Increased success of offer initiations by 15% for an internal tool by identifying an issue and reimplementing an internal matching algorithm used to communicate with separate microservice.
● Coordinated and led initiatives for team building activities within engineering pod of 10 employees.
● Collaborated with product managers, designers, stakeholders, and other engineers using agile practices to deliver new features over the course of one or more sprints for internal tooling.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
React ● Redux ● Java ● Spring ● Thrift

● Navigated and contributed to the microservices architecture composed of 5+ engineering teams and UX, 10+ services, 100+ modules, with 1000+ APIs. Often dealt with requests spanning multiple services.
● Led the team as Scrum Master and coordinated group efforts through the organization of weekly meetings and standups. Worked with PM and EM to prioritize work and meet the quarter’s milestones.
● Served as project lead for implementing a company initiative that increased ad serving opportunities
● Identified bottlenecks within API calls and used concurrent programming to better performance.
● Ported code from a 6-year-old legacy app (Angular/C#/.Net) to our modern app (React/Java/Spring).
● Created seamless user experience by automating workflows and reporting metrics for internal tools.

positions.title: Software Engineering Immersive Resident
positions.description:
● Mentored 50+ junior engineers through a project-based software engineering program.
● Coordinated with teaching staff to enhance and iterate on the current curriculum.

positions.title: Fetsy
positions.description:
● Refactored legacy codebase to implement MVC structure and improve readability.
● Built seed script to create and store 44 million realistic data entries in under 1 minute.
● Enhanced performance of GET requests from 450 RPS to 1750 RPS (400% increase) and decreased overall latency with a combination of caching, vertical scaling, and horizontal scaling using Redis, Nginx, and AWS.

positions.title: Somebirds
positions.description:
● Built two microservices (Product & Images) in addition to a reverse proxy server.
● Designed application’s Restful API as part of a small agile engineering team.
● Created a simplistic and fluid UI for the application’s components.
● Implemented test-driven development using Jest, Enzyme, and circleCI.

positions.title: Director Of Tennis
positions.description:
● Organized and expanded both the adult and junior programs of 100+ participants. 
● Executed short and long-term financial goals to hit monthly and annual targets (200-250K).
● Recruited, trained, and led new professional hires for our department.

positions.title: Tennis Professional
positions.description:
● Built, managed, and maintained client relationships. >95% Rebooking rate.
● Organized and lead new tennis programs for both adults and youth.
● Handled various financial transactions for tennis related services.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
A web app built to connect local stringers with tennis players. Our company set out to revolutionize an age-old process by modernizing the means of transactions while also delivering a product right to the customer's door. It offered convenience for our customers, increased accessibility and visibility for stringers, and most importantly it helped educate our tennis community on niche stringing knowledge.

● Modernized the stringing service model by using proprietary technology and E2E services.
● Established a loyal customer base of around 50-60 clients over a 4-month time frame.
● Created and executed different marketing strategies leading to 10x targeted impressions

positions.title: Director Of Operations
positions.description: Oversight and event coordination at the premier professional men's tennis tournament in Northern California.
